description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentDao class, which manages database operations related to employee attachments in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting employee attachment records, as well as handling partial attachment data transfer objects.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeAttachment entities, providing CRUD operations and specific queries related to employee attachments.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PartialEmployeeAttachment objects associated with a specific employee and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmployeeAttachment entity based on employee number, attachment ID, and optional screen.

methods.name: getPartialEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a partial view of an employee attachment as a DTO based on employee number, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment entity to the database, assigning a new attach ID if necessary.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple attachments for a specified employee and screen based on provided attachment IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a single EmployeeAttachment entity from the database.
